data.one_liner: Flutter SDK that captures logs, prints, errors and streams them to Logmonitor.io in real‑time
data.what_it_does: It intercepts package:logging records, print() and debugPrint() calls, and Flutter framework errors, then batches and sends them to Logmonitor.io. In debug mode it logs to console, in release mode it posts to the server.
use_when: You need real‑time log monitoring for production apps
You want to capture all print() and debugPrint() output without manual wrappers
You want to tag logs with a user ID for easier filtering
You need a zero‑overhead solution in debug builds
avoid_when: You only need simple console logging
You already use another error monitoring service like Sentry and don't need duplicate logs
strengths: Zero network overhead in debug mode
Automatic print and error capture via zones
User association for per‑user log filtering
Full platform support (Android, iOS, Web, macOS, Windows, Linux)
weaknesses: Requires opt‑in flags for print and error capture
Relies on package:logging for structured logs
No built‑in UI for log viewing (requires Logmonitor.io dashboard)
data.setup_notes: Add logmonitor_flutter and logging to pubspec, call Logmonitor.init() after WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized(), optionally use Logmonitor.runGuarded() and setUser()
